title: Hierarchical Neural Collapse: Pre-registered experimental bundle (Paper P1)
description:
Code, pre-registration, and shuffled evaluation corpora for the paper Hierarchical Neural Collapse: An Intrinsic 60° Angular Signature in Multi-Scale Byte-Level Language Models.

This Zenodo release is the immutable snapshot that the OSF pre-registration (osf.io/hkt6c) points to. Predictions P-C1..P-A5 (see LINEAS CONSOLIDADAS DE TRABAJO/OSF-PREREG-P1.md) were frozen prior to running the experiments A2, A3, and P1-TRCTRL.

Includes: statistical utilities (stats_helpers.py), corpus generator with fixed seed (prep_shuffle_corpus.py, SEED=20260420), three shuffled WikiText-103 validation corpora (paragraph / sentence / word level), and the pre-registered experimental scripts.
